## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes
- [ ] The Game Design Document is updated if behaviour or design changed
- [ ] No hard-coded player-facing text (use `locales/en.json`)
- [ ] New dependencies and assets have GPL-compatible licences and are listed in `CREDITS.md`
